crossRefs.note: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.
For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.
The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
“For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh.
“For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God, and does his will, he listens to him.

translations.web: Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
translations.bsb: The LORD is far from the wicked, but He hears the prayer of the righteous.
translations.kjv: The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
translations.asv: Jehovah is far from the wicked; But he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
